method.sources: Same ten recorded episodes (both arms) and ten executed sim attempts from ../manifest.json; not all104
method.segmentation: 50Hz. 15sample/poly3 derivative for cuts. Low speed <0.012m/s for >=0.30s; deep trough <35% neighboring 1s peaks, prominence >=0.02m/s; gaps between cuts >0.30s. Retain >=0.4s and >=2.5cm. Identical motion-only rules across sources; controller phases only annotations.
method.shape: 201 equal arc-length points. Gaussian sigma5mm for shape metrics,15mm broad view, pinned endpoints. Near-straight: displacement/path>=0.94 and lateral/displacement<=0.12. Reverse/return: negative chord/principal-axis progress/path>0.08 or efficiency<0.45. Others curved. These are descriptive thresholds, not validated behavior labels.
method.context: Endpoint20% mean speed <0.5*p95 means deceleration. Human gripper change>=0.12 over0.2s, within [-0.2,+0.8]s of endpoint adds evidence; simulation approach/carry ends used for corresponding planned gripper event. No detected ring/pole pose/contact labels. Not proof of insertion or success.
method.speed: Original7sample derivative from parent analysis; no timing normalization except separate progress plot. Do not imitate raw spikes.
method.normalization: Per-segment start-to-end axis and chord scale; return-like uses principal axis. Scale denominator max(chord,0.1*path). Raw metric paths remain available.
method.selection: Individual segments preserved; no averaged trajectories. Both real arms kept separate, episode/pass status retained. Automatic label errors can be exported as manual corrections.
